changelog:
🎨 A brand-new admin panel: a fast React app built into the binary, in English, 简体中文, Português (Brasil) and Tiếng Việt, with light and dark themes.
📊 Overview dashboard that updates live: KPI cards with hourly trends, per-minute live tiles, traffic over time, a model-mix donut and traffic by account.
👥 Accounts with status tabs and counts, filters, sorting, batch actions, connection tests, export and a per-account outbound proxy, machine ID and Kiro profile.
➕ Eight ways to add an account: AWS Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Microsoft SSO, SSO token, Kiro IDE local cache, credentials JSON, Kiro web cookie and Kiro API keys.
📜 Requests log with status tabs and counts, search (it also matches the full API key), sorting and a detail view, kept in SQLite across restarts.
🔑 Client API keys with token and credit limits, plus syntax-highlighted setup snippets for curl, Claude Code, Codex and the OpenAI SDK.
💾 Backups with a schedule, upload and one-click restore.
🔁 Opt-in auto-continue for answers cut at Kiro's output cap, and earlier tool calls sent as structured tool history so long agent sessions keep calling tools.
🧠 Claude output effort reaches Kiro, and tool calls that Kiro leaks as markup are turned back into real tool calls.
📡 Streams send a keepalive during long silences and replace the fixed 5-minute timeout with an idle watchdog.
🧹 System prompt filter and ordered model mappings, both checked when you save them.
🔒 The server listens on 127.0.0.1 by default, and while API keys are required the last enabled key can no longer be disabled or deleted.
